question_text: How busy was the food court during lunch hours on average?
answer_text: For cameras with location containing "Food" between hour_utc '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z' and '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z', the weighted average headcount during lunch was 120.01 (1 camera reported across 2 hours with total_samples 7200). The mean hourly average headcount was 120.00999999999999, mean peak was 142.5, max peak was 146, and min hourly average was 119.97.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(cam:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(loc:Location)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z'
  AND (
    (ch.camera_location IS NOT NULL AND ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'Food')
    OR (cam.camera_location IS NOT NULL AND cam.camera_location CONTAINS 'Food')
    OR (loc.name IS NOT NULL AND loc.name CONTAINS 'Food')
  )
RETURN
  count(DISTINCT cam.camera_id) AS cameras_reporting,
  count(ch) AS hours_count,
  sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples,
  CASE WHEN sum(ch.event_count) > 0 THEN toFloat(sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count)) / sum(ch.event_count) ELSE NULL END AS weighted_avg_headcount,
  avg(ch.avg_hc) AS mean_hourly_avg_hc,
  avg(ch.peak_hc) AS mean_peak_hc,
  max(ch.peak_hc) AS max_peak_hc,
  min(ch.avg_hc) AS min_hourly_avg_hc
